about_the_game:
Stand out from other hunters in the Dragonkin world and customize your city as you wish with this new free DLC for Dragonkin: The Banished. Founder Pack 2 contains:

  • 6 exclusive pieces of equipment including a chest and helmet for your heroes (2 per character)
  • 6 exclusive visual effects allowing you to add a drag to your dragonkin
  • The exclusive “Day of the reaper-Drake” complete pack including cosmetic elements for your city: statues, roofs, flags and pennants.

This pack of cosmetic elements will only be available for download for a limited period from the release of the first game update on May 20, 2025 until the release of the second Early Access update in summer 2025. Once this date has passed, it will no longer be possible to obtain these elements.

short_description: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!
